description: This Dart source file defines models and a provider class for fetching and listening to report data (daily and weekly summaries) in an attendance tracking app. It includes data models for summaries, a provider class that interacts with an API and real-time service, and manages state updates and notifications.

classes.name: DailySummary
classes.description: Immutable class representing a daily attendance summary with JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: WeeklySummary
classes.description: Class representing a weekly attendance summary with JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: ReportProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that fetches daily and weekly reports, manages state, and listens to realtime report updates.

methods.name: DailySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DailySummary instance from JSON data.

methods.name: DailySummary.toJson
methods.description: Converts a DailySummary instance to JSON.

methods.name: WeeklySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a WeeklySummary instance from JSON data.

methods.name: WeeklySummary.toJson
methods.description: Converts a WeeklySummary instance to JSON.

methods.name: ReportProvider.fetchDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily summary data either from mock data or via API, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: ReportProvider.fetchWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly summary data from API or mock data, updates state, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: ReportProvider._handleRealtime
methods.description: Handles incoming realtime messages and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: ReportProvider._formatDateKey
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string key in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.
